crossRefs.note: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your…
for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…
For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always…
who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

translations.web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
translations.bsb: For none of us lives to himself alone, and none of us dies to himself alone.
translations.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
translations.asv: For none of us liveth to himself, and none dieth to himself.
